wrap_module_with_ddp: wrap a PyTorch module with DistributedDataParallel using fairseq2 gangs for multi-GPU training
broadcast_buffers_across_gang: broadcast persistent buffers of a module across all processes in a gang at initialization
configure_all_reduce_hook: register a custom all-reduce communication hook to skip gradient normalization by world size
use_ddpmodule_type_alias: use the DDPModule type alias as a type hint for PyTorch DistributedDataParallel wrapped modules
handle_meta_device_initialization: handle meta device initialization by materializing the model on rank 0 and emptying on other ranks
